verdict.rationale: Sentry documents running all of Sentry on your own server, and a community user reports running self-hosted Sentry in production for years as rock-solid. However, the official self-hosted offering is described as a minimal setup for simple use cases with no guarantees or dedicated support, and community reports describe steadily growing container and memory footprints and heavy maintenance effort. missing for 10: documented self-hosted architecture, documented upgrade path or upgrade procedure, production-grade support guarantees, scaling guidance beyond simple use cases.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path

citations.quote: How you can run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything.
Sentry offers and maintains a minimal setup that works out-of-the-box for simple use cases. This version comes with no guarantees or dedicated support.
They have run self-hosted Sentry at work for a couple of years and it has worked fantastically; once running it is rock-solid.
